hadith:
One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus) - Narrated Asma bint Abu Bakr:

I used to carry the date stones on my head from the land of Az-Zubair which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had given to him, and it was at a distance of 2/3 of a Farsakh from my house. Narrated Hisham's father: The Prophet (ﷺ) gave Az-Zubair a piece of land from the property of Bani An- Nadir (gained as war booty).
message: Allah, The Shaper of Beauty, has crafted this world with perfect wisdom—yet He reminds us through the Quran that those who turn away from His guidance will face severe consequences in the afterlife, deprived of all comfort and mercy. Let this knowledge inspire us to recognize the beauty in His creation and respond with gratitude, obedience, and righteousness, so that we may be among those who taste His mercy rather than His punishment.
name:
Al Musawwir - الْمُصَوِّرُ - The Shaper of Beauty

Al Musawwir is one of the names of Allah in Islam, highlighting His role in shaping and defining the forms of all beings. The name emphasizes the intricate design and beauty of creation, illustrating that all forms and features in the universe are crafted by the Creator. The understanding of this name encourages believers to recognize the deliberate and purposeful creation of the world around them.
